$comment: T-3.32. The grey-box mission's enemies (world greybox-01, T-3.31), played by server/src/ai/director/spawner.ts. A group: `members` (archetype and count), the spawn `zone` it appears in (the world's mission.spawnZones), its `posture` (hold: stand where it spawned facing `face`, the start by default; patrol: walk from where it spawned through `route` and round again; garrison: take cover inside `at` and fight from there), its `trigger` (start; time, seconds since the start; enter, any living squad soldier inside an area; dead, another group with every member sent and none alive), and `waves` (again every `everySeconds`, `count` waves in all). `areas` are the places triggers and postures may name, beside the mission's own `start` and `objective`. Never more than `aliveCap` enemies alive; never a spawn a human can see at any of the `probes` heights above its feet.
